name: Opal pendant
about: Opal is Australia's national gemstone, and Sydney's shops sell designer pieces made from natural stones. It makes a classic gift from the city.
tip: Ask whether the stone is natural, doublet, or triplet. Natural opals cost the most, so this matters for a high-priced gift.

name: Merino wool goods
about: Merino wool comes from sheep bred in Australia, and it is soft and warm. Socks and scarves in this wool are common souvenirs.
tip: Check the label for the merino percentage before you buy.
